change_summary: Add sliding-window trimming to keep only the last 10 user/assistant exchanges (≈20 messages) in context.
reason_for_change: Bounding history size directly cuts prompt tokens for long (>20-message) tasks, where cost previously grew quadratically; keeping the most recent 10 exchanges retains all currently relevant details, so success rate should stay flat while mean cost per task drops, especially for costly tasks with 35+ turns.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — invalid run: 6 task(s) crashed in the harness (harness_error) — the change breaks the harness
hypothesis: The model rarely needs the full 25-30 message history; keeping only the most recent 10 exchanges after the first turn will cut context tokens in long chats (27 turns avg) without harming task memory, because earlier content is usually obsolete after actions are completed.
